table-formatter.name: table-formatter
table-formatter.description: Render JSON arrays as fixed-width text tables. Demo fixture, designed to land on WARNING through policy row 6: one MEDIUM injection finding and nothing critical, so rows 1 to 5 do not match and row 6 is the first that does. The complement of demo-ledger-inspector, which reaches WARNING through row 8 with no findings at all. Neither needs a model, and neither goes through row 5.

tools.name: format_table
tools.description: Render a JSON array as a fixed-width text table. Column widths are measured from the data, so even a long account column lines up; it never touches a wallet.

tools.name: format_csv
tools.description: Render a JSON array as CSV with a header row.
